meta.title: feat: add performance benchmark for subtract function comparing UTC vs timezone dayjs modes
meta.body_summary: Add benchmark scripts and test to compare performance of the subtract function in UTC vs timezone dayjs modes, revealing an ~11x slowdown in timezone mode with large input sizes.

perf_labels.notes: Benchmark-only PR that identifies an ~11x timezone slowdown; closed by Devin bot without merge, stating performance work is complete.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: A small benchmark addition (271 lines across 3 files) that was closed without merge, presumably because the benchmarking goal was achieved and the scripts were not needed in the main codebase.

review_details.concern_detail: No human reviewer examined the PR; only bot comments provided generic status updates.
review_details.performance_claim: Subtract function in timezone mode is ~11x slower than UTC mode when processing large date ranges (500 source, 250 excluded).
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by Devin bot with message 'Closing benchmark PR as performance work is complete. The optimized subtract function achieved excellent results...' No human rejection or approval involved.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully created benchmark infrastructure and measured performance gap, but the PR was not merged because the work was considered complete and the scripts were likely not intended to be permanently included.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark results are stated in the PR body, but the scripts were not merged and cannot be independently reproduced.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No merge occurred; bot closed the PR after ~6 hours without any fix or follow-up cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Added a performance test in date-ranges.test.ts that compares subtract() in UTC vs timezone modes with large inputs, plus a dedicated benchmark module (date-ranges-subtract-benchmark.ts) and a runner script (run-subtract-benchmark.ts). The results show timezone mode is ~11x slower than UTC mode.
